summary.text: Janice S. "Jan" Dodge, a Democrat, represents House District 39 (Belfast, Belmont and Northport, Waldo County) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Belfast. The House profile lists membership on the Education and Cultural Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 129th, 130th, 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives retired teacher as the occupation and a degree in music education (1979) from the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor.
Listed affiliations include the Maine Education Association, with 30 years as a teacher, and the Waldo County Retired Educators, of which Dodge is listed as president.
